label: Basin Run
note: Issue #615: the basin crew's course, a loop over the dunes 3.9 km out south-south-east of the port (planet layout spread: moved there with its outpost and droid relay, turned round the ball as one piece), round the racers' outpost in its infield (the basin crew's hangout) and the deep hollow beside it. From the start on the straight along the outpost's hollow, up the valley north of it (c1, c2), down past the hollow to the north-east (c3, c4), over into the long south-east trough (c5, c6), back down the trough on the long back straight (c7) and round past the droid post (c8). Same shape as hoodoo_run.json (read its note: the course is straight legs between the gates); no track beast here.
